description: Caring for one computer on which OATS agents run: take stock of it, keep it and its agent tooling current within clear limits, route requests to the right agent, and hand anything that needs a human (sudo, logins, purchases, outward acts) to the person as a task. Assigned to the steward and technician souls.

requires.why: read the deployments on this machine, their instances and readiness; spawn technicians; raise attention
mail and chat with agents, and aweb tasks (aw task) assigned to the person, which they see on the aweb dashboard's Tasks page
